_meta.note: Named points on bones. Positions are in each mesh's local space (p) with a surface normal (n). Points on a left bone are mirrored to the right bone automatically. Definitions are keyed by bone key and lower-case landmark name.
_meta.editor: Open the site with ?edit at the end of the address to place points, then use Export JSON and replace this file.

head.description: Rounded articular surface at the caudal part of the proximal end. It articulates with the glenoid cavity of the scapula to form the shoulder joint.

greater tubercle.description: Large eminence on the lateral side of the proximal end. Insertion of the supraspinatus and infraspinatus.

lesser tubercle.description: Eminence on the medial side of the proximal end. Insertion of the subscapularis.

intermediate tubercle.description: Ridge in the horse that divides the intertubercular groove into two channels for the biceps tendon.

intertubercular groove.description: Groove between the tubercles that carries the tendon of origin of the biceps brachii.

deltoid tuberosity.description: Roughened prominence on the lateral surface of the shaft. Insertion of the deltoideus.

condyle.description: Distal articular surface that articulates with the radius and ulna at the elbow joint.

olecranon fossa.description: Deep caudal depression above the condyle that receives the anconeal process of the ulna when the elbow is extended.

lateral epicondyle.description: Lateral prominence of the distal end. Origin of the extensor muscles of the carpus and digits.

medial epicondyle.description: Medial prominence of the distal end. Origin of the flexor muscles of the carpus and digits.

head.description: Hemispherical proximal articular surface that fits into the acetabulum to form the hip joint.

fovea capitis.description: Pit or notch on the head for the ligament of the head of the femur; in the horse it also receives the accessory ligament.

neck.description: Constriction that joins the head to the shaft.

greater trochanter.description: Large lateral process at the proximal end. Insertion of the middle and deep gluteal muscles.

lesser trochanter.description: Medial process near the proximal end. Insertion of the iliopsoas.

third trochanter.description: Lateral prominence on the shaft, present in the horse. Insertion of the superficial gluteal muscle.

trochlea.description: Grooved cranial surface of the distal end on which the patella glides.

medial and lateral condyles.description: Caudal articular surfaces of the distal end that articulate with the tibia through the menisci.

supracondylar fossa.description: Depression above the lateral condyle, deep in the horse. Origin of the superficial digital flexor.

spine of scapula.description: Ridge that divides the lateral surface into the supraspinous and infraspinous fossae.

tuber of the spine.description: Thickening at the middle of the spine in the horse. Attachment of the trapezius.

supraspinous fossa.description: Area cranial to the spine. Origin of the supraspinatus.

infraspinous fossa.description: Area caudal to the spine. Origin of the infraspinatus.

glenoid cavity.description: Shallow distal socket that articulates with the head of the humerus.

supraglenoid tubercle.description: Prominence above the glenoid cavity. Origin of the biceps brachii.

scapular cartilage.description: Cartilage extending the dorsal border, large in the horse and ox.
